title: LLM Daily
oneLineOutcome: My goal was to learn AI fundamentals in a gamified way, similar to Duolingo, so it actually felt fun. How I built it: I used Fable 5 and Grok 4.6 in Cursor to write 27 lessons covering LLMs, how models get trained, RAG, evals, agents, and how to think about AI as a PM. I fed in YouTube videos from Andrej Karpathy and others as source material, and made sure every concept was broken down into an analogy, a real example, and a quiz.

title: Claude Inbox Zero
oneLineOutcome: My goal was to build a cheap AI email assistant based off of Inbox Zero. How my agent works: every day it triages my Gmail inbox, labels threads under an InboxZero/ namespace, and drafts replies in my voice for threads that need a response. I added a feedback loop so it continuously improves to sound like me: it studies my sent mail and diffs its drafts against what I actually sent. It also hunts the zombie subscriptions I never open, and ends each day with a digest of what needs me, what got filed, and what to unsubscribe from.
